Class ShieldGenerator

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.Component
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.ShieldGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ShieldGenerator extends Component
Represents a shield generator component that can protect specific sides of the spaceship. The shield generator can be activated for one-time use and its orientation can be changed to protect different sides of the ship.

    • isActive

      public boolean isActive()
      Checks if the shield generator is currently active and automatically deactivates it. This method implements a one-time use mechanism where checking the status consumes the activation.
      Overrides:
      isActive in class Component
      Returns:
      true if the shield was active (and is now deactivated), false if it was already inactive
